question: What is our win rate by reason code, and where are we losing the most dollars?
text:
Across all reason codes, we won about 47.7% of resolved disputes (4,509 won out of 9,461 resolved) and lost about $3.03M. This covers month-ends from July 2024 to June 2026.



**Where we lose the most dollars:**
- **10.4 Card-Absent / Friendly Fraud is the biggest problem.** We lost $1.14M here, about 38% of all losses and roughly double the next code. We win only 35.2% of these disputes and lose about 62% of the dollars disputed ($1.14M of $1.85M).
- **13.1 Merchandise Not Received is second** at $563K lost, even with a 54.6% win rate. The loss is mostly because there are so many of these disputes.
- **4837 No Cardholder Authorization has the lowest win rate (31.6%)** but only $181K lost, because the dollars involved are small.
- **The other codes (13.2, 13.3, 4853, 12.6) all win about 53–56% of the time.** Together they lost about $1.14M.

**What to do next:** The two fraud and authorization codes (10.4 and 4837) are where we win least. Better evidence on friendly-fraud cases under 10.4, such as delivery proof and device and login data, would recover the most dollars.

tables.title: Win Rate and Dollars Lost by Reason Code (Jul 2024 – Jun 2026)

sql: SELECT reason_code, reason_name, SUM(won_count) AS won, SUM(resolved_count) AS resolved, SUM(won_count)/NULLIF(SUM(resolved_count),0) AS win_rate, SUM(lost_amount) AS lost_usd, SUM(total_dispute_amount) AS disputed_usd, MIN(month_end) AS start_month, MAX(month_end) AS end_month FROM __d GROUP BY reason_code, reason_name ORDER BY lost_usd DESC NULLS LAST
